title: Python Introduction
transcript: Python is a programming language commonly used for web development, automation, data analysis, and machine learning. Python is popular because its syntax is easy to read and it has many useful libraries.

title: Machine Learning Introduction
transcript: Machine learning allows computers to learn patterns from data. Supervised learning uses labeled training data while unsupervised learning attempts to discover patterns without predefined labels.

title: Database Introduction
transcript: SQLite is a lightweight relational database. Unlike database servers such as PostgreSQL, SQLite stores its database inside a local file. It is useful for smaller applications and caching.
